label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 252 ]

blocks.text: Market researchers often comment that the elderly think of themselves as being much younger than they actually are. In fact, research confirms the public's belief that age is more a state of mind than of body. The level of a person’s mental outlook and activity has much more to do with quality of life than does actual age. A recent study suggests that perceived age may be a more reliable predictor of marketing success on the gray market than actual age. For this reason, many marketers focus on perceived age in marketing campaigns.
